offence_note: Historical sexual assaults and assaults on daughter and stepdaughters
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a total sentence of 3 years imprisonment.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted, appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Break and enter counts, attempt, possession of break-in instruments
sentence_quote: I impose a global three-year sentence.
note: Credit one-for-one because bail denied on record.

offence_note: Breach of conditional sentence order (house arrest)
sentence_quote: I sentence you to 90 days in jail to be served as a part of the house arrest portion of your conditional sentence order.
note: 90 days served within house arrest portion of CSO; CSO extended; original CSO length not shown.

offence_note: Arson and possession of stolen property over $5,000
sentence_quote: this Court imposes a sentence of 28 months, with credit for 472 days of real time served prior to sentencing. After providing you with enhanced credit of 708 days, this leaves 132 days remaining for you to serve in custody
note: Victim surcharge waived; Gladue weighing not visible in excerpts; concurrent 9 months on count 3.

offence_note: Child pornography, receiving benefit from, advertising and procuring sexual services
sentence_quote: we substitute a global sentence of 15 months of imprisonment on the charges for which he has been convicted, to be followed by 18 months of probation.
note: Trial sentence was one-year suspended sentence; new trial ordered on other counts; mandatory minimums struck.

offence_note: Manslaughter of wife by injection of anaesthetics
sentence_quote: Although I would grant leave to appeal his seven-year sentence, I would dismiss his sentence appeal.

offence_note: Breach of release conditions (s. 145) on summary conviction
sentence_quote: I sentence Ms. Gabriel to 30 days' custody for the March 26, 2018 Section 145 offence. In the interests of justice, I stay that sentence and the associated victim fine surcharge.
note: Crown appeal allowed; 30 days custody imposed but permanently stayed; other counts had CSO and probation not under appeal.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking and production of marihuana
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal and reduce the sentence to time served.
note: Original sentence 15 months; eight months already in custody.

offence_note: Trafficking in cocaine-like substance; breach of recognizance or probation
sentence_quote: With that change to the probation order, the sentence would remain the same, but I would allow the appeal and make that change.
note: Only the probation area restriction was amended; longest sentence 45 days concurrent.

offence_note: Second degree murder by shooting with sawed-off rifle
sentence_quote: In my view, the appropriate period of parole ineligibility is 12 years.
note: Life sentence mandatory for second degree murder; weapons prohibition for life.
